Located in the [[Thomquizzar system/Legends|Thomquizzar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the '''Thomquizzar Naval Base''' belonged to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Vocis Kenit]], who was serving in the navy, was assigned a dirtside post to the base<ref name="Orbit" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Kenit served well, and he reported the political errors of his rivals and superiors, which led to him being promoted and transferred away from the base.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thomquizzar Naval Base was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', authored by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1998]]. In ''The Far Orbit Project'', the base's name is written as Thomquizarr Naval Base.<ref name="Orbit" /> Later in [[2009]], the reference title ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' named the system that the base was at as Thomquizzar.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> This article assumes the newer spelling is correct.
